caption:
A bullet tears through a crowded city.
Seedance 2.5 chased one bullet across the whole city.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 39 seconds. 2.35:1 anamorphic widescreen (1280x548). Ultra-realistic live-action Chinese crime-thriller look: shot on a wide 18-24mm lens, shallow depth of field, cool desaturated teal-grey grade, soft overcast late-afternoon daylight on wet grey pavement for the city run, then deep night with colorful neon bokeh for the finale. Camera feel: "bullet-cam" — a high-speed FPV chase camera locked a few centimetres behind a flying bullet, gliding, banking and weaving at street level with heavy motion blur on the surroundings while the bullet stays razor sharp; key passes drop into extreme slow motion (bullet time). Pacing: one near-continuous bullet flight through the city with quick slow-motion beats, a 2-second title card, then a slow, tense night close-up that ends with the shot that fires the bullet into the lens.

SIGNATURE ELEMENT — THE BULLET: a small polished brass-gold bullet seen from directly behind as a round gold disc with a darker centre ring, about 1/40 of the frame width, always locked in the exact centre of frame during every flight shot (SHOT 2-14). MUST SHOW in every one of those shots.

CHARACTERS:
- THE SHOOTER: Chinese man, about 30, light tan skin, sharp jaw, intense dark narrow eyes, thick black messy hair down to his collar with long centre-parted bangs falling over his brows. Two-tone high-collar zip jacket: left half and left sleeve black, right half and right sleeve white, black turtleneck under it. Same face and jacket in SHOT 1 and SHOT 16-20.
- GUM GIRL: young Chinese woman, about 20, long straight black hair loose over her shoulders, red sleeveless top.
- BUS PASSENGER: young Chinese man, about 25, short black hair, black jacket, holding a smartphone.
- FIRE PERFORMER: street performer in a bright red-and-yellow costume and red cap, holding up a large burning hoop.
- POLICE DRIVER: stocky Chinese man, about 50, weathered tanned skin, short black hair, black leather jacket.
- OK-SIGN GIRL: young Chinese woman, about 22, glossy black chin-length bob with straight bangs, loose cream blouse.
- APPLE GIRL: young Chinese woman, about 25, shoulder-length dark hair, beige trench coat, warm smile.

LOCATION: a modern Chinese megacity commercial district: tall glass skyscrapers and shopping malls with huge digital billboards of smiling faces, a wide pedestrian plaza of wet grey stone paving, a large intersection with white zebra crossings, crowds of pedestrians, white-and-red city buses, white sedans and green taxis, street-food carts with pink umbrellas. Overcast sky, everything slightly wet and reflective. The finale is the same city at night: a packed pedestrian street lit by colorful neon signs, blurred into bokeh.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:00.4) — Flash-forward. Low-angle medium shot in the plaza: THE SHOOTER stands mid-pose, right arm raised high holding a thin black fountain pen, left arm swept out, the white half of his jacket splashed with red stains; skyscrapers and blue billboards behind. Hard cut.
SHOT 2 (00:00.4-00:03.7) — Launch. Bullet-cam at ankle height skimming fast over the wet grey paving stones of the plaza; pedestrians' legs and shoes streak past on both sides in heavy motion blur; the camera banks slightly and rises to knee height as it bursts out into the big intersection, a white-and-red bus crossing far ahead. MUST SHOW: the gold bullet centred.
SHOT 3 (00:03.7-00:05.6) — The bubble. Medium side view at the crossing: GUM GIRL in profile (facing right) blows a pink bubble-gum bubble that swells from fist-size to bigger than her head; the bullet flies straight into the centre of the bubble and, in slow motion, pierces it — the bubble bursts into flecks of pink gum. MUST SHOW: the big glossy pink bubble right of her lips.
SHOT 4 (00:05.6-00:07.7) — Her reaction. Close-up profile as the camera glides past her face in slow motion: a fleck of pink gum on her cheek, she gasps, eyes wide, mouth open in a round "O", turning her head to follow the bullet; buses and crowd blurred behind.
SHOT 5 (00:07.7-00:08.9) — Into the bus. Wide, then rushing closer: a white city bus with a red stripe crosses frame left to right; the bullet races alongside it and darts in through an open side window into the dark interior.
SHOT 6 (00:08.9-00:12.2) — Inside the bus. Slow motion, camera gliding along the aisle at seat height: passengers on blue plastic seats stare down at their phones; the bullet floats past BUS PASSENGER's face, he lifts his head from his phone and turns, his eyes tracking the bullet in disbelief as it slides past him and out of the far window.
SHOT 7 (00:12.2-00:14.9) — Ring of fire. The bullet exits the bus low over a zebra crossing, between a white sedan and a green taxi, and streaks across the intersection toward food carts with pink umbrellas; FIRE PERFORMER holds up a large hoop of roaring orange flame; the camera rushes in and the bullet threads exactly through the centre of the burning hoop, flames filling the frame edges. MUST SHOW: the blazing ring with the bullet centred inside it.
SHOT 8 (00:14.9-00:16.0) — Police car. Low wide: a white police patrol car with a dark-blue stripe and a flashing blue light bar (no lettering) swings across the intersection; the bullet flies along its side and slips in through the open driver's window.
SHOT 9 (00:16.0-00:18.5) — The driver. Inside the car, slow motion, side profile: POLICE DRIVER grips the steering wheel; the bullet drifts past just in front of his face; he frowns, eyes shifting to follow it, as it leaves through the passenger window toward the crowd outside, where OK-SIGN GIRL stands.
SHOT 10 (00:18.5-00:20.9) — Through the OK sign. Camera rushes toward OK-SIGN GIRL standing in the crossing crowd; smiling playfully, she stretches her right arm toward the lens and makes an "OK" sign; the bullet passes exactly through the ring of her thumb and index finger in a slow-motion close-up, her hand filling half the frame, her smile turning to astonishment. MUST SHOW: the finger ring framing the bullet.
SHOT 11 (00:20.9-00:22.7) — The apple. The bullet weaves through the crowd past a man in a white T-shirt toward APPLE GIRL in her beige trench coat; a shiny red apple hangs in the air in front of her face; the bullet hits it and in slow motion the apple bursts into a spray of white-fleshed slices and juice around her smiling face. MUST SHOW: the apple exploding into slices.
SHOT 12 (00:22.7-00:25.0) — Balloon column. The bullet swings upward and climbs fast along a tall vertical string of round balloons (purple, yellow, red, blue, pink, orange) rising above the street, billboards and traffic blurred below; an orange balloon swells until it fills the frame and pops.
SHOT 13 (00:25.0-00:26.0) — Balloons scatter. High angle over the intersection: red, green, pink and yellow balloons break loose and drift away as the bullet rises above the traffic.
SHOT 14 (00:26.0-00:27.0) — The billboard. The bullet soars high across the intersection toward a huge white billboard with a woman's portrait on a rooftop frame and strikes its centre.
SHOT 15 (00:27.0-00:29.2) — Impact card. Locked-off full-frame pale silver-grey surface like cracked frosted glass, thin spiderweb cracks radiating from a small bullet hole in the centre. No text.
SHOT 16 (00:29.2-00:36.3) — The shooter. Night. Centred front close-up of THE SHOOTER on a packed neon street, crowd and pink, blue and orange neon signs blurred to bokeh behind him; he stares straight into the lens, a faint smirk, then slowly raises a black semi-automatic pistol from the bottom-left of frame until the muzzle points straight at the lens in the foreground (soft focus), his sharp face behind it; his lips part as if whispering. Very slow push-in.
SHOT 17 (00:36.3-00:36.6) — Muzzle flash. He fires: a bright orange-white fireball of muzzle flash fills the centre of frame and the gold bullet bursts out of it.
SHOT 18 (00:36.6-00:37.4) — The shot. Medium-wide: THE SHOOTER in the neon crowd, arm extended, pistol smoking, the brass bullet streaking from the barrel straight toward the lens.
SHOT 19 (00:37.4-00:38.6) — The glass. The bullet strikes an invisible pane of glass right in front of the lens: spiderweb cracks shoot out across the whole frame from the bullet lodged in the centre, his blurred figure behind.
SHOT 20 (00:38.6-00:39.3) — Into the lens. The bullet punches through the glass and slams toward the lens until its blurry brass tip fills the frame; cut to black.

SOUND: no dialogue. A tense, driving cinematic electronic beat with deep bass pulses throughout the flight; a constant high-pitched bullet whistle and wind rush; muffled city ambience, footsteps and traffic. Accents: wet bubble pop (SHOT 3), bus engine and passenger murmur (SHOT 6), whoosh and roar of fire (SHOT 7), police siren chirp (SHOT 8), juicy apple burst (SHOT 11), rapid balloon pops (SHOT 12-13), a sharp glass crack on the title card (SHOT 15). In SHOT 16 the music drops to a low drone with muffled night-street crowd noise; a huge gunshot on SHOT 17, glass cracking (SHOT 19), a final impact boom and silence at black.
prompt_short: Realistic 2.35:1 thriller, bullet-cam: a brass bullet flies through a rainy-grey Chinese city, popping a bubble, crossing a bus, a fire hoop, an OK sign, an apple and balloons; at night a man in a black-and-white jacket fires it into the lens.
